name: Semerarete ~Onna Shachou~
source:
Main character yearns for eroge industry and searches for a vacancy in leading developer brand companies. But when he gets an interview, he arrives late. He terribly apologizes and tries to go home when female company president stops him with words "I'll try you".

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-july-2006-bra-ban.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
男主角向往成人游戏业，在顶尖开发品牌公司寻找空缺职位。可获得面试机会后，他却迟到了。他拼命道歉，正准备回家，女社长叫住了他：
「我来试试你。」

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-july-2006-bra-ban.html]vndbreview[/url]]
